exercises.board: Ch3 L2 card 5 (Spot the doji) · choice with candle glyphs

card.name: Try it
card.title: Spot the doji
card.q: Which candle shows that buyers and sellers ended the day even?

options.feedback: A long red body: sellers won that day.
Open and close at almost the same price: a draw.
A long green body: buyers won.
Red body: it closed well below its open.

exercises.board: point · tap the candle that confirms the double bottom

card.name: Try it
card.title: Find the trigger
card.q: Tap the first candle that confirms the double bottom.
card.right: That close above $34, the middle high, confirms it.
card.wrong: Confirmation is the first close above the middle high, $34.

exercises.board: order · Three lines, in this order

card.name: Try it
card.title: Read it in order
card.q: Put an earnings report in the order you read it.
card.right: Revenue, then EPS, then guidance: the future moves the price most.
card.wrong: Start with sales, then profit per share, then what the company expects next.

exercises.board: line · place the stop below support

card.name: Try it
card.title: Place the stop
card.q: Support runs from $79.50 to $80.50. Drag your stop to a sensible price.
card.right: Just below the zone: a normal poke into support won’t stop you out.
card.wrong: The stop belongs a little below the whole support zone, around $79.
